name: Modbus Client → On Error
description: Fires on a Modbus exception response. Lambda variables: `request` (`std::span<const uint8_t>`, the request PDU this action sent - same as in `on_response`) and `exception_code` (`modbus::ExceptionCode`, an enum - cast to `int`/`uint8_t` to print). There is no `response` span, as an exception carries no data payload.
